title: National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation (NSFDC)
sourceDescription: NSFDC official website, 'Eligibility Requirements' page. Fetched live and transcribed for this corpus.

sections.text: The beneficiary(ies) must belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) community. Individuals, Partnership Firms, and Co-operative Societies are eligible to undertake income-generating activities. For Partnership Firms and Co-operative Societies, all members must belong to the SC community.

The annual family income of applicants must not exceed Rs. 5.00 lakh for credit/loan-based schemes, applicable to both rural and urban areas. For Partnership Firms and Co-operative Societies, the annual family income of each individual member/applicant must not exceed Rs. 5.00 lakh. There is no income criterion for participation in Skill Development Training Programmes.

Applicants are required to apply for financial assistance from NSFDC through the concerned State Channelizing Agencies (SCAs) or Channelizing Agencies (CAs) — NSFDC does not lend directly to individuals.
